Thanks Vanessa / Anna — I reviewed the attached draft. We can commit to the following contract language:

1) No-adaptive-training clause: "Redwood certifies that tenant data received under this Agreement will not be used to further train or improve models (including weights updates or gradient-based training) without Customer's explicit prior written consent."

2) Subprocessor disclosure: we will list the subprocessors and regions in an appendix and provide an operations attestation showing where copies of interactions may be processed.

3) Evidence scope: we can deliver an evidence pack containing:
   - Subprocessor inventory and region map
   - KV/prefix caching behavior and retention defaults
   - KMS usage and residency options (AWS KMS, GCP KMS — specify onshore key residency where available)
   - Proofs: access logs snapshot, ephemeral storage description, and SFTP export readiness checklist.

I made inline redlines in the attached PDF (healthbridge_dpa_redline_v2.pdf) and added a suggested appendix layout. If HealthBridge requires a legally stronger onshore KMS guarantee beyond our existing dedicated-private options, we should note that as an optional enterprise add-on and I'll flag for Legal Ops.

Vanessa, please confirm procurement timeline; Anna, if procurement needs additional evidentiary items let us know now so we can include them in the first pack.

Hi all — pulled together the ops evidence checklist and current subprocessor posture. See summary below and attached detailed checklist (ops_evidence_checklist.xlsx).

Summary (ops):
- Subprocessors touching EU data: AWS (eu-west-1) for inference runtime; Google Cloud (europe-west) for batch analytics (if enabled); SFTP partner (OnshoreTransferCo) used for export requests.
- Default flow: API traffic to our EU region inference fleet; ephemeral KV caches retained for session duration (24h default), stored encrypted at rest.
- KMS: We use AWS KMS by default; we can offer customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private deployments — for hosted customers we can restrict key residency to EU regions where available.
- Evidence deliverables (target Wed Aug 12):
   * Subprocessor inventory CSV (regions + access scope)
   * Access log sample (anonymized) showing processing timestamps
   * Snapshot of policy for ephemeral caches and retention
   * SFTP export readiness checklist (OnshoreTransferCo contact + SLA option)

Operational constraints / notes:
- Onshore KMS guarantee requires Dedicated or Private deployment; for hosted we can provide onshore SFTP exports and an attestation of region processing but not a baked in onshore KMS unless we move to a dedicated key for HealthBridge.
- If HealthBridge requires a hard contractual prohibition on any derivative usage, we will include the no-adaptive-training clause but need to coordinate continued monitoring (alerts/traces) to provide the evidence pack for audits.

Links:
- Evidence folder (internal): https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-healthbridge-onboarding
- Ops runbook excerpt: https://jira.example.com/browse/OPS-1145

I'll upload the ops_evidence_checklist.xlsx now. Vanessa — if procurement needs a shorter SLA window for the pack (e.g., 48 hours) call it out and we will prioritize.

Thanks,
